summary: SOL Strategies Inc. (filer) announced closing of its acquisition of HoudiniSwap LLC on June 1, 2026, for USD $18 million total purchase price, payable in a mix of cash and common shares. Cash component was financed via decentralized finance protocols on Solana using the company's balance sheet, without selling treasury SOL. Houdini is a non-custodial, privacy-focused cross-chain swap aggregator with ~$2.5B cumulative volume and ~$13M 2025 revenue. Full terms reference a prior press release. This foreign private issuer filed on Form 6-K; board appointed Jon Matonis as Chairman. Watch for integration execution and revenue contribution from Houdini.
